review.why: Speed up slow SQL: read the query plan, fix common anti-patterns and design indexes for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite.
review.summary: A five-step process: collect query context, read the execution plan, apply rewrites for common anti-patterns (SELECT *, missing indexes, N+1, functions on indexed columns, correlated subqueries, deep OFFSET), recommend indexes, and report the original and optimized queries.
strengths: Concrete before and after rewrites, including an ORM N+1 fix.
Warns that EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement and shows how to roll it back.
Index design rules: equality before range, composite column order, write overhead.
cautions: Covers PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite only; nothing for data warehouses.
Advice is general: the real improvement must be measured on the actual database.
Examples were not run against a database here.
